messages:
meera: POC with Harbor Capital failing schema checks. Their CI flags fncall JSON where trade_id is null intermittently and ordering differs. Need a quick mitigation before their demo tomorrow.

dave: paste sample and any logs pls.

meera: sample they provided:
{
  "trade_id": null,
  "amount": 4500,
  "status": "PENDING"
}

infra-bot: log: [2026-03-21T21:10:12Z] req=ht77 model=redwood-2-stream mode=json error=schema_violation field=trade_id; rate_limit=429 Retry-After=3

eli: root cause: streaming boundary can cause truncated or literal 'null' tokens. Also their CI retries are spiking QPS and hitting 429s. Short-term options: (1) non-streaming validation endpoint for CI (streaming=false) (2) enable json_mode.stable_key_order=true and json_mode.drop_nulls=true on POC route as a temporary compatibility toggle (warns about masking missing data) (3) recommend client backoff honoring Retry-After.

dave: can you push the canary with those toggles? I'll ask them to rerun in 20m. Also we'll offer a temporary small dedicated pool to avoid shared quota 429s.

eli: pushing canary now. infra-bot: config-change by eli for route/harbor-poc {"json_mode":{"stable_key_order":true,"drop_nulls":true},"streaming":false} rolling to canary

infra-bot: canary results: 10 validation runs, 0 schema_violations. No 429s in canary window. Temporary QPS bump to 500 approved for 2h by sales-ops.

meera: Harbor reran CI against canary and passed. They accepted non-streaming validation for the demo. Follow-ups: eli to open INF ticket for permanent fix; dave to prepare pricing note for discounted trial dedicated pool; meera to send one-paragraph attestation about PII handling.

eli: INF-12077 created: "Harbor POC - streaming nulls & deterministic serializer" https://go.redwood/infracase/INF-12077

dave: pricing email drafted, sending now.

meera: closing for now. Re-open if any regression. :white_check_mark:
